title: fix: ensure directories exist before building with `--sourcemap`
author: goestav
summary: The CLI writes the .map file before creating the output directory, so `--sourcemap -o missing/dir/out.css` fails with ENOENT. The PR creates the parent directory first and adds a CLI test. Six-line CLI-only fix.
evidence: master 574eee2 CLI: `lightningcss --sourcemap -o outd/x/out.css in.css` -> `Error: Os { code: 2, kind: NotFound, message: "No such file or directory" }`. Cause in src/main.rs: fs::write(map_filename) runs before the existing create_dir_all(output_file.parent()). A slightly cleaner alternative is moving that existing create_dir_all above the map write, but the PR is correct as is. Possible textual conflict with #1315 (adjacent lines).
